name: Harlan
catchphrase: The iron remembers, even when I don't.

personality.trait: Patient, methodical, frustrated by sudden incompetence
personality.quirk: Taps hammer rhythmically but skips a beat

glitched.speaker: Harlan
glitched.text: I'd offer you something freshly forged, but...

glitched.speaker: Harlan
glitched.text: My hands know the motions. Heat, fold, strike.

glitched.speaker: Harlan
glitched.text: But I keep skipping the first part. The preparation.

glitched.speaker: Harlan
glitched.text: It's like that step just vanished from my mind.

questGiving.speaker: Harlan
questGiving.text: You seem like someone who notices things others miss.

questGiving.speaker: Harlan
questGiving.text: My work used to flow — preparation, then the craft.

questGiving.speaker: Harlan
questGiving.text: Now the preparation vanishes. Like it was never there.

questGiving.speaker: Harlan
questGiving.text: Could you look at the forge? Something in the sequence broke.

healed.speaker: Harlan
healed.text: I can feel it. The rhythm — it's back.

healed.speaker: Harlan
healed.text: Prepare, then forge. How did I ever forget that?

healed.speaker: Harlan
healed.text: Thank you, friend. My hands remember again.
